sql.value: select d.id, d.name, d.description, d.category, d.items_json, d.item_count, d.enable_status, d.sort, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time from ai_eval_dataset d where d.is_deleted = 0 #[and d.name like concat('%', :name, '%')] #[and d.category = :category] #[and d.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by d.sort desc, d.id desc
